newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end down, near day's lows as Dow weakens.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end down, near day's lows as Dow weakens.

text.p: UK shares dropped on Friday as a fresh bout of jitters hit Wall Street and gilts dropped sharply amid profit-taking and political worries after a local election defeat for the ruling Conservative party.
The FTSE 100 index closed 30.9 points lower at 4,308.3, having earlier bounced off the 4,300 support level. Losers were in a seven-to-two majority,

With concern already growing over next Friday's U.S. jobs report, traders said there were fears that this week's warning of overvalued shares from Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan could be preparing the ground for a rise in interest rates.
